spec.description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Permishield XV 70 is an Australian-made, fibre-free, closed-cell thermo-reflective insulation and sarking engineered specifically for framed and reverse brick veneer walls behind lightweight claddings[][][]. It combines thermal insulation, a thermal break, and a vapour-permeable sarking pierced with evenly spaced breather holes into a single 3-in-1 product[][]. It protects the wall structure from external water penetration while allowing internal moisture vapour to escape, significantly reducing interstitial condensation risk[][].
features: Water-resistant and unaffected by moisture (passes water barrier test)[][][
spec.fire: Flammability Index ≤ 5 (Low) to AS 1530.2; Group 1 to AS/NZS 3837; early fire hazard 0/0/0/0-1 to AS 1530.3[][
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4859.1:2018, AS/NZS 4200.1, CodeMark Certified for NCC compliance, NCC 2019/2022 thermal break R0.20 compliant[][][][
spec.sustainability: Fibre-free core; non-allergenic; non-irritant; low VOC; zero ODP; Australian made[][][
install: Fix Kingspan AIR-CELL Permishield XV 70 loosely to outside of frame, leaving flexibility to dish into cavity if required [1.1.9]
Install with anti-glare face facing outward towards the installer[][
Cut carefully around doors, windows, and openings so that it neatly abuts frames[][
Butt join sheets and tape all joins with 48mm wide Kingspan reinforced foil tape[][
When taping, use a plastic squeegee or blade to apply firm, even pressure[
Provide outer air space by adhering Kingspan AIR-CELL Spacer Biscuits to outer face (approx. 3 per square metre)[
Maintain minimum 50mm clearance around heat-producing flues and recessed light fittings[
Fix counter-battens and exterior cladding in accordance with cladding manufacturer instructions[
selection_checklist: Verify lightweight cladding manufacturer requires a Class 3 vapour-permeable membrane[
Confirm need for R0.20 thermal break on steel studs to satisfy NCC energy provisions[
Ensure 48mm reinforced foil tape and spacer biscuits are included in quantity calculations[
limitations: Can be damaged by intense heat above 105°C; keep away from sparks and naked flames [1.2.9]
Aluminium facings are electrically conductive; avoid contact with live electrical wiring[
Not suitable for roofing applications requiring sarking with zero vapour permeance[][
Surfaces must be clean, dry, and free of dust or grease prior to taping[

problem_keywords: meeting NCC R0.20 thermal break requirement
use_cases: wrapping steel-framed residential walls behind fibre-cement cladding to deliver an R0.20 thermal break and vapour breathability
installing in reverse brick veneer constructions to control heat flow and prevent condensation
insulating timber-framed walls behind lightweight cladding requiring Class 3 vapour permeance
not_for: pitched or flat roof sarking where Class 1 or 2 vapour barrier is mandatory
direct floor underlay under tiles or floorboards
retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Permishield XV 70 is an Australian-made 7.2mm thick, 3-in-1 thermo-reflective insulation, thermal break, and Class 3 vapour-permeable sarking. Manufactured with a closed-cell polyolefin core sandwiched between reflective foil facings and pierced with micro-breather holes, it provides an in-situ material R-value of R0.20 to satisfy NCC thermal break provisions on steel-framed walls. It allows internal moisture vapour to breathe outward while blocking external liquid water, making it the premier choice behind lightweight claddings and reverse brick veneer wall assemblies.
